findings.title: Admin nav marks 'New task' / 'New mission' as current page while editing an existing item
Malformed XSRF-TOKEN cookie makes every admin mutation throw a raw URIError
FormAlert layout effect re-runs and refocuses on every parent render when errors is rebuilt per render
Hashed assets are served with a 1-year expiry but without immutable
findings.reason: A location-level add_header would stop nginx inheriting the http-level security headers (CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy) for /assets/; the config forbids that on purpose. 'expires 1y' already caches the hashed files; immutable only saves a revalidation on reload.

findings.title: Edit mission screen highlights "New mission" as the current nav item
Wrong-moment frame: task list provenance still shows a PDF viewer with an empty right pane
findings.reason: The clip's assertions (FR-13 filters and provenance) passed; the still is one frame. Its verdict belongs to the open vision-verify re-run of the 11 phase6-admin-theme clips (not run: budget spent).

findings.title: Dark theme: mission-card progress dots are almost invisible
findings.reason: Empty progress dots are decorative; the same card states the progress as AA text ('0/3 vyřešeno'). Dot colours are design-system tokens, which a feature may not change (AGENTS.md); goes to the design-system artifact.

findings.title: pdf.js opened with default isEvalSupported=true on admin-uploaded PDFs (CVE-2024-4367 class)
findings.note: verification skipped by the budget cap; treated as confirmed
